issue_request: FHIR-20605 was Published/Persuasive and asked Pharmacy to add a MedicationRequest.intent comment saying intent is immutable, proposal instances should not become plan or order instances, a new basedOn instance should be created for a changed intent, and Request.intent granularity changes such as order to filler-order remain allowed.
initial_application: Jira cited a6310682, merged from 8c0d5b260d, as the CI-build application. That 2019 Pharmacy change touched MedicationRequest source but did not add the requested MedicationRequest.intent wording. The current immutable sentence and '(immutable)' short text were later added by FHIR-50000 in cb9d506ccc, leaving the older granularity exception absent.
additional_context: FHIR-15686 established the Request.intent immutability rule and current source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml still contains the same granularity exception. FHIR-20603 spawned per-resource trackers including FHIR-20605. Later Pharmacy decisions FHIR-50000 and FHIR-48887 reaffirm immutable MedicationRequest.intent and existing workflow/request-pattern context without rejecting the order/filler-order exception.
reconciliation: Updated source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml, which is in build scope via source/fhir.ini, to add the granularity exception to the MedicationRequest.intent comment between the immutable-intent sentence and the existing Pharmacy-specific requester guidance.
